newsitem.title: INDIA: Calcutta shares end lower, ITC falls.
newsitem.headline: Calcutta shares end lower, ITC falls.

text.p: Share prices fell at the Calcutta Stock Exchange (CSE) on Tuesday led by scandal-hit ITC shares, brokers said.
The CSE index index dropped 5.09 points, or 1.22 percent, to 412.45.
The brokers said domestic and foreign investors pushed sales of blue-chip stocks unnerved by the investigations into financial irregularities at tobacco conglomerate ITC Ltd.

"The developments have delivered a body blow to the secondary markets. We are in the middle of panic selling. Large investors have deserted the market as buyers are now busy liquidating their holdings of Indian paper," said Aprajit Sharma of brokers Jet Age Securities.
